full_judgment: 11. On the other hand, Mr. Bivash Chandra Biswas learned Advocate appearing for the respondent nos.1-6 in support of the impugned judgment and order passed by the High Court Division submits that the suit for partition simpliciter without prayer for title and khan possession in the suit land is not maintainable. The learned Advocate though admits that the plaintiffs failed to prove their 'pattan' by which they are claiming their title in the suit land but submits that the defendants also failed to prove their case by adducing documents inasmuch as the burden of proof also lies upon the defendants under section 103 of the Evidence Act and there is no reason to interfere with the impugned judgment and order passed by the High Court Division.
